name: lwt
description: Companion to the LEAPWare TokenWise Claude Code plugin, now with the same enforcement: an engine identical to it, an enforcing PreToolUse hook (hooks/hooks.json), and lwt-config/lwt-report skills.

interface.longDescription: lwt makes an AI coding session's spend rules mechanical. Both the Claude Code and Codex plugins enforce via a PreToolUse hook backed by the same lwt_core policy engine, with lwt-config and lwt-report skills for inspecting and previewing policy.
interface.defaultPrompt: lwt: show the current token policy and report on the last action.
